BrochureContent.Content:
Number 27 is a much welcomed addition to the property market as it presents immaculately and features all mod cons. An A rated four bedroom family home perfectly positioned within this recently built development will be in strong demand whilst impressing the most discerning of buyer.

The aesthetically pleasing exterior and equally tasteful interior will no doubt attract immediate attention. Nicely matured this development in general is renowned for quality family homes built to exacting standards featuring manicured open greens and lush leafy walkways. The location is excellent as Delgany Village and Greystones town are both only a short drive away.

The bright layout features an excellent balance between bedroom and living accommodation comprising well appointed living spaces in addition to four bedrooms. The jewel in the crown is the spacious kitchen accessing the south facing rear garden via glass French doors.

As more and more people avail of a work life balance Delgany and Greystones as locations continue to represent as top priority for buyers who still want to be close to Dublin accessing pubic transport links whilst availing of this scenic mountain and sea on top of many a buyers lists as one of the most desirable places to live.
